chapter: Fisher's band and Jack Laine's bands
title: Emmett Hardy following Brunies for ideas
summary: Brunies recalls young cornetist Emmett Hardy, who followed him around to pick up ideas and died too young.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well, yeah, but tell us about Emmett Hardy. Did you know him when he was starting out on drumming?

Yeah, Emmett Hardy was a good little jazz connet player. So, he used to come up and he used to follow me all over and try to get ideas and all like that for me. And he went out and he went out wonderful. And it's a pity that he had to die so young. He did, yeah. He did, yeah. He did, yeah. He did, yeah. And, uh... Roger. And the Hardy. And the Hardy, yeah. That was it. And Dick, what about the carnival balls?
